methods.description: Distinguish an ordered sequence, its series, a single nth term and the sum of its first n terms.
List or generate the first n terms with the given nth-term rule, then add those terms to evaluate S_n.
Use S1=a1; for a later specified numerical term subtract the preceding partial sum, removing the shared terms.
Identify the first and last required term, subtract the earlier partial sum from the later one, and evaluate the resulting interval sum.
